long_biography.plain_text:
After military service and graduate school, Blaine J. Sweatt III joined General Mills Restaurants in 1976 and moved through menu-planning, purchasing and finance roles. Five years later, he became director of new concept development. He eventually led the division responsible for finding restaurant ideas capable of becoming national brands.

Sweatt's teams developed Olive Garden, China Coast, Bahama Breeze, Smokey Bones and Seasons 52. He joined the launch group when Darden separated from General Mills, serving as new-business president and a founding director. As executive vice president, he helped shape a multibrand growth strategy before retiring in 2007 after three decades with the company.

uncertainties.detail: The immutable source record is the only located source directly assigning Intuition to Blaine J. Sweatt III. YachtBuyer independently matches the exact 130-foot, 298-GT vessel but does not name an owner. Paturzo Yacht Design independently identifies Blaine Sweatt as owner of Marbella II and records his direct account of more than 40 years of boating. The rare suffix, Orlando geography, Darden and UCF records, LinkedIn profile and yachting history make the person resolution very strong, but the exact Intuition title is not publicly corroborated.

The authoritative display name Blaine J. Sweatt III is preserved. Corporate and SEC records frequently omit the middle initial, while Darden, UCF and regulatory records consistently retain the III suffix. Searches also produced Blaine Swett and other unrelated namesakes; none shares the exact suffix, Orlando, Darden and yachting anchors and none is used.

The 1947 birth-year proposal is triangulated from Darden's August 2005 age of 57 and Sweatt's direct statement that he would be 77 in 2024. The latter uniquely resolves the otherwise possible 1947/1948 range, but it appears on a self-maintained alumni page rather than a civil or biographical authority. No birth day, month or place is proposed.

Sweatt retired from Darden in 2007. UCF currently labels him owner of Ivanhoe Design, but the official Florida registry lists that company inactive since 2019. His 2024 direct profile says he remains active in real estate and community philanthropy without identifying a principal company, asset base or income mechanism. Current primary industry is therefore Unknown; Restaurant groups remains the historically defining wealth-creation sector.

SEC filings establish substantial Darden salary, incentives, shares and options and therefore a clear causal career mechanism. The dossier does not treat historical option-value tables as current net worth, infer ownership of all Darden concepts, or attribute any family, spouse, yacht or company assets beyond what exact-person sources establish.

No dedicated Forbes profile or exact-person Forbes article was found. The upstream LinkedIn URL matches the exact name and Orlando career context and is retained without a duplicate proposal. No verified Instagram or personal website was located. UCF and Ivanhoe pages are research sources, not substitutes for unsupported social accounts.

Restaurant groups is the minimum useful approved active tag because Sweatt held a defining long-term operating mandate across a multibrand restaurant portfolio. Restaurant franchising is omitted because his causal career evidence concerns company-owned concept development rather than a defining franchise mandate. Restaurateur is also omitted because the sources identify him more precisely as a corporate concept developer and executive than as an independent restaurant proprietor.

Both biographies exclude Intuition, Marbella II, vessel specifications, compensation figures, current travel, family detail and uncertain post-retirement holdings. They retain military service and graduate school only as concise formative context for the well-sourced restaurant career and keep all source attribution invisible.
